target: temporary workers.dev Worker and temporary Cloudflare R2 bucket

methodology.execution: Disposable Azure Node 22 clients ran current browser query planning over HTTPS. Writes executed inside the temporary Cloudflare Worker against R2.
methodology.candidate: Eight immutable index shards selected by document ID, with shard metadata embedded atomically in the collection HEAD.
methodology.baseline: Current one-page immutable secondary index per definition.
methodology.primaryLatency: clientElapsedMs measured around the complete regional operation

limitations: The fixed ID partitions require every query to read all eight shards.
The candidate is experimental and is not a public package export or production protocol.
Azure regions approximate geography and do not represent residential last-mile networks.
One Cloudflare account and one R2 bucket placement were used.
Authentication and application rendering were excluded.
The benchmark compares ThimbleDB index layouts, not another database.
